meta.name: baoyu-article-illustrator
meta.description: Analyzes article structure, identifies positions requiring visual aids, generates illustrations with Type × Style two-dimension approach. Use when user asks to "illustrate article", "add images", "generate images for article", or "为文章配图".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为文章自动生成匹配的插图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为文章快速生成风格统一的插图。
copy.tagline_en: Generate matching illustrations for your articles automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate style-consistent illustrations for articles.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析文章结构，找出需要配图的位置，然后根据你选择的类型（如信息图、场景图）和风格（如极简、水彩）生成配图，并插入到文章中。
howto.when: 当你要求“为文章配图”、“添加图片”、“illustrate article”或“generate images for article”时触发。

say.text: 为这篇技术教程配图，类型用信息图，风格用极简。
say.note: Claude 会分析文章，生成信息图风格的配图。

say.text: 给这个叙事故事配场景图，风格用水彩。
say.note: Claude 会生成场景图，风格为水彩。

say.text: 为这篇文章配图，密度选每节一张，风格用手绘。
say.note: Claude 会按每节一张的密度生成手绘风格配图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes the article structure, identifies positions needing illustrations, and generates images based on your chosen type (e.g., infographic, scene) and style (e.g., minimal, watercolor), then inserts them into the article.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "illustrate article", "add images", "generate images for article", or "为文章配图".

say_en.text: Illustrate this technical tutorial with infographic type and minimal style.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and generate infographic-style images.

say_en.text: Add scene illustrations to this narrative story in watercolor style.
say_en.note: Claude will generate scene-style images in watercolor.

say_en.text: Illustrate this article with per-section density and hand-drawn style.
say_en.note: Claude will generate one image per section in hand-drawn style.
